Bidirectional trace table: every field of a composed authoring/v1 contract cites EITHER (a) trace_kind=anthropic-spec-derived — the 6767-h section it implements plus the live anthropic_doc URL, OR (b) trace_kind=is-only-extension — the IS-only-extension category, a rationale for why it has no upstream anchor, and the upstream_convergence_trigger that would mechanically MOVE it to upstream-base. Three CI gates consume this file (§ 14.2.3): coverage-map-completeness (every composed-schema field has an entry), prose-anchor-validity (every anthropic-spec-derived 6767h_section resolves against schemas/prose-anchors/6767-h.headings.json), is-extension-rationale (every is-only-extension entry has non-empty rationale AND upstream_convergence_trigger). 6767h_section values are validated against the vendored heading inventory — only sections that actually exist there are cited (HONEST + conservative; § 14.2.2). NOTE: this file's 6767h_section citations live in the structured `6767h_section` field, NOT in any $comment — the prose-anchor gate scans $comment fields for the schema family and would otherwise double-count; the coverage-map's own anthropic-spec-derived citations are validated by check-coverage-map-prose-anchors.ts (the § 14.2.3 gate #2 extension). [2t2p] EXTENDED to ALL SIX authoring contracts. Field set per contract = the union of the v2 composed-schema top-level `properties` keys (upstream-base + is-overlay); trace_kind is determined from base/overlay membership, which mirrors the captured projection (specs/_vendor/upstream/<contract>/projection.json) per DR-062 (the v2 base encodes documented-upstream fields only): a field present in the upstream-base layer is documented-upstream; an overlay-only field is IS-only/kernel-only. DISPOSITION: (a) plugin-manifest documented-upstream fields cite 6767-h §2 (Plugin Manifest), the required `name` cites §2.1 (Required Fields); marketplace-catalog documented-upstream fields cite 6767-h §4 (Marketplace & Website Safety Contract), the required name/owner/plugins cite §4.1 (Source of Truth) — both contracts HAVE a 6767-h section, so their documented fields are anthropic-spec-derived. (b) agent-definition / mcp-config / hook-config have NO 6767-h section (the 6767-h master spec scopes ONLY plugin-manifest + skill + marketplace), so EVERY field of those three contracts is classified is-only-extension with a null 6767h_section — matching the skill-frontmatter convention exactly (no resolving 6767-h section ⇒ is-only-extension, never anthropic-spec-derived-with-null, which the prose-anchor gate forbids). For their DOCUMENTED-UPSTREAM fields the upstream provenance is NOT dropped — it is recorded in the rationale (the Anthropic sub-agents/mcp/hooks doc surface that documents the field) under category documented-upstream-no-6767h-section, with an upstream_convergence_trigger that re-classes the field to anthropic-spec-derived once 6767-h adds a covering section. Genuinely IS-only/kernel-only fields (metadata, the IS tracking trio version/author/tags, mcp enabled, etc.) carry their own IS-extension category. lineage: dr-044@d-sak-1
